business_problem: DNP needed to preserve institutional knowledge, standardize inconsistent expert work, and automate research, security, and operations tasks across a very large industrial enterprise facing labor constraints and complex information flows.
solution_summary: DNP deployed ChatGPT Enterprise across ten high-impact departments after first creating a secure company-wide environment for generative AI. Teams use shared prompts and custom GPT patterns to automate patent research, classify and summarize competitor IP, create first-draft reports, structure English patent and equipment information, generate Python code for analysts with no prior experience, and speed security-review and cloud-compliance work. The same platform is also being used to digitize paper manuals and historical quality logs into a searchable internal knowledge base that future custom GPTs can access. Rather than treat AI as a side experiment, DNP set quantitative adoption benchmarks, made usage visible, and pushed patterns across departments so knowledge reuse, processing volume, and task automation could scale together. Human verification remains in place, but the operating model increasingly turns expert judgment into structured digital labor reused across the company.

data_flow: Patents, manuals, audit materials, cloud-compliance findings, and historical quality logs are brought into ChatGPT Enterprise, where teams summarize, classify, and structure them into reusable outputs. The resulting artifacts feed custom GPTs and an internal knowledge base so the same expertise can be reused across departments with human verification at the end.
business_outcome: DNP achieved measurable results in 90% of use cases, reduced patent-research time by 95%, doubled technical-paper review throughput, automated large parts of security and cloud-compliance work, and created a path to preserve frontline knowledge as reusable structured data.
